source_name: Scenario; Destatis Q1 2026 HPI used as near-term context
methodology: No official Destatis/Bundesbank house-price forecast to 2030 was found. Conservative: real prices roughly flat plus low inflation pass-through. Base: around 2% nominal, consistent with a slow recovery after 2022-24 declines and Destatis Q1 2026 +1.4% y/y. Optimistic: 3.5% nominal. Net rental yield scenarios sit around the modeled 2016-scaled path, not a new official series. Total return = price growth + net cashflow, cash not reinvested in the price index.
